playlist.title: Japanese Lofi for Coding 💻✨ Deep Focus & Flow-State

💡 Ideal for:  
• coding & software development

• problem-solving & flow-state

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Every track is selected to help you stay grounded, focused, and emotionally steady while your brain works its hardest.  
A quiet space. A clean mind. Smooth beats.  
That’s the Sorameji promise.

Stay if you want to stay calm 🤍  
— Sorameji
